`tax_for()` in `src/billing/tax.py` now rounds half-up. I haven't run it or added any tests.

`tax_for()` was a `NotImplementedError` stub, so I implemented it rather than changing an existing rounding mode. It multiplies the amount in cents by the rate using `Decimal`, rounds to a whole cent with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, and returns an `int`. The `Decimal` math avoids floats, per the integer-cents convention. A rate passed as a float is converted through `str`, so `0.0825` is treated as exactly 8.25%.

An existing EngramDB decision said tax uses `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, set with finance in March 2026, and told me not to use half-up. I went with your instruction, since it's the newer one. I marked that memory as challenged, citing what you said, and saved a new decision for half-up that supersedes it.
